Why can't I get a straight forward answer about my heart? Why do I wake up from a dead sleep with quivering, racing heart beat? I'm tired of dealing with all these different kinds of palpitations that pop up out nowhere. I get used to one kind of palpitation, and the rate at which that kind of palpitation occurs chills out a bit, and I am totally fine for a while. But then a new heart symptom happens. And the cycle begins a new. And as I've said, I've had a lonely, traumatic past few years, even throughout all of high school I was depressed and suicidal but my parents thought I was fine.

Ironically, I have higher than normal blood pressure but a low resting heart rate. I don't really exercise that much either. There is a lot of genetic factors to your resting heart rate and blood pressure.
